entries.english:
Instrument concerning the rights of the Count of Tyrol in relation to the court and measures of Bolzano and the Isarco bridge, 1234.

At Bolzano, on 24 July 1234, witnesses swear to the rights and obligations concerning the maintenance and use of the Isarco bridge, including the provision of timber and other materials, the Count of Tyrol’s jurisdiction over the bridge, the obligations of inhabitants and officials, market rules, standards of measurement, and the annual court session. The instrument records the testimony and rulings made in the presence of the count and numerous named witnesses.
